summary: The standing a decision record carries, as a small closed set, plus a crosswalk from every status line the forty existing records already use. The crosswalk exists so this contract can be adopted without rewriting a single decision record: a reader keeps its own prose, and this file says what that prose means.
not_in_scope: Whether a decision is right. Standing is about who has settled it, never about whether it is so.
Artifact standing. OPEN -> BUILT -> WITNESSED -> RATIFIED grades an artifact; this grades a record's settlement.

PROPOSED.plain_english: Drafted. Nobody has ruled on it.
PROPOSED.blocks: Only the transitions its own routing entry names. A proposal blocks no neighbouring work (decisions/0031).

RULED_BELOW.plain_english: Settled at Control or Work tier, which decisions/0033 Ruling 1 says is where a question belongs when evidence at that tier can defeat the alternatives. The owner may still reject or redirect the outcome; he is not waiting to permit it.
RULED_BELOW.blocks: Nothing. The ruling stands until a defeating observation demotes it.

OWNER_DIRECTED.plain_english: Bdo asked for this. The direction is settled; the record's exact wording may still be a proposal, which its routing entry says.

OWNER_ACCEPTED.plain_english: Accepted over evidence, after the fact. Never pre-approval (decisions/0023).

SUPERSEDED.plain_english: Replaced by a later record, which the status line names.

owner_held_categories.product_intent: What the system is for and what it contains. A new chartered boundary or a change to the primary interface lands here.
owner_held_categories.public_naming: What the thing is called in public.
owner_held_categories.external_commitment: A promise made outside this machine.
owner_held_categories.irreversible_external_effect: An effect that cannot be counter-recorded away.
owner_held_categories.acceptance_standing: A change to something the owner already accepted, or to the acceptance rule itself.

crosswalk_note: Every status string observed across decisions/ on 2026-08-23, mapped to a standing, plus the six strings records 0052-0059 minted afterwards and which were added on 2026-08-24 while main and feat/federation-harness-and-hardening were reconciled. Twenty-two distinct strings for forty records is the condition this contract exists to end; the crosswalk is the bridge, not the destination. A status string absent from here is a defect the checker reports rather than guessing at.

owner_questions_section.heading: What still waits on Bdo
owner_questions_section.plain_english: A decision record states its own owner questions as a list under this heading, one bullet per question. Routing then reads a list instead of inferring from prose, which is the interpretive step that produced both defects an independent witness found in the first version of contracts/acceptance-routing.json.
owner_questions_section.grandfathered: Records 0001 through 0042 are exempt and stay exempt. Exactly one of them - 0036 - carries the section, and only because its author happened to write it; nothing asked for it. Retrofitting the other seventeen would mean one reader inventing questions on behalf of records other people wrote, which is the failure this rule exists to end. Named as existing debt rather than silently grandfathered, the way scripts/lint.py handles module size.
owner_questions_section.bare_ratification_excluded: A bullet saying only that the record awaits ratification is not a question. Every PROPOSED record awaits it, so counting it would mark every record and say nothing.
